name: Golden Chess — One Golden Move
subtitle: One move that changes the game
promotionalText: Chess with one golden move: once per game, teleport a piece to any empty square. Free, no ads, no sign-up. Tap Play and you're in a game.
keywords: chess,golden move,chess variant,chess puzzles,chess bot,play chess,online chess,rating,coach,free
description:
We may have fixed chess.

One evening two friends got tired of seeing the same patterns on the board and tried one extra rule: once per game, each player may teleport a queen, rook, bishop or knight to any empty square. No capture, no check, just the piece landing where it is needed most. We played the rest of that visit on a wooden board and never went back. This app exists so we could keep playing after he flew home.

That one move is the golden move. While either player still holds it, every position stays tense: a rook can land behind your lines, a knight can appear next to your king, a bishop can close a diagonal at the last second. By our engine's count a golden move in hand is worth about 150 Elo, yet it rarely decides a game by itself. A beginner still won't beat a master. What changes is that no move is ever routine, and a lost position is still a game.

Everything else is the chess you know: castling, en passant, promotion. The first minute feels familiar. Every game after that doesn't.

PLAY
• Tap Play and you're in a rated 3+2 game. No sign-up: sign in later to keep your rating on any device.
• Bullet, blitz and rapid, with a Golden Chess rating of your own.
• Eight bots from 600 to 2500, each with its own style, from a park player to a machine.
• A friend by link, or two players on one phone.

UNDERSTAND
• A full review after every game: accuracy, mistakes, blunders and the golden moves you missed, with what they would have done.
• A coach that explains each mistake with the line that punishes it, and shows the best line, golden moves included.
• Learn: the rule in pictures, then puzzles where one golden move does it.

We wrote our own engine for the variant, because no existing one knows the golden move. The analysis that costs money elsewhere is free here. The whole app is free: no ads, no subscriptions, no catch. We built it in our free time, for chess and for friends.

Not another Chess960. The board and the openings are the ones you know; the game is not.

English and Russian.

review.notes:
Golden Chess is a chess variant: regular chess plus one "golden move" per player per game (teleport a queen, rook, bishop or knight to any empty square; no capture, no check).

Most of the app works without an account: tap Play → Bots and play any bot; Play → Two players for a local game; Learn for the rule and puzzles. Online rated games and the game history need an account.

DEMO ACCOUNT: sign in with the e-mail and password given above (Profile → Sign in → "I have a password"; the default sign-in is a 6-digit code sent by e-mail). With an account you can also play a rated game online and open the review of any finished game (Profile → History → Start review); a game against a bot shows the same review without an account.

Sign-in options in this build: Sign in with Apple, Google, e-mail (6-digit code) and e-mail + password.

The app shows the live web app (golden-chess.com) in a native shell; the chess engine runs on the device.
